audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven rows disagreed with packet.levelChart (Skill/Poppy/Poppy/Skill/Poppy/Poppy/Yone) and with their own whys — the chart handed Yone levels 3, 4-5 and first item while the whys describe those as Poppy windows. The diff enum also read EVEN beside a 4/10 difficulty, a green tone and a report line calling it a favoured matchup.
audit.why: 54.74% win rate over 939 games with the whys saying 'force fights here' at first item; the chart said the opposite.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 flipped as matched full+content pairs with ratings updated; diff set to FAV to match diffRating, tone and report[14].

audit.why: Level 6 as Poppy's peak and 2+ crit items as Yone's takeover match the kit and the packet chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly called Soul Unbound (E) a dash that Steadfast Presence grounds. Riot's text is 'Yone's spirit leaves his body behind, gaining Move Speed... forced back to his body' — no dash, and the kit lists no dash flag on E. Spirit Cleave was never mentioned at all despite being a shield on a 14s cooldown.
audit.why: Holding W to stop Soul Unbound wastes it. The dash W actually stops is Mortal Steel at two Gathering Storm stacks. And bursting into a fresh Spirit Cleave feeds the shield.
audit.corrected: W advice retargeted to the Q3 dash; Soul Unbound described as a spirit return on 22/19/16/13/10s; Spirit Cleave's 14s shield now the thing to bait before committing.

audit.why: Spirit Cleave's 14s decides trades, Soul Unbound's 22s decides all-ins, and Mortal Steel's 4s means his poke is never the window.
audit.corrected: Numbers now stated on the lines that depend on them.

edits.before: Passive shield trades + Q zone control win early. Identify how Yone contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Both of you are weak on one ability — deny his Mortal Steel last-hits and set up the wall angle you want at level 2.

edits.before: W deletes his dash mid-flight — hold it like a parry. Only take the trade when Yone's Soul Unbound is down.
edits.after: Q+E online: one wall-stun off his Q3 dash chunks him hard before Soul Unbound can pull his spirit out.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Yone must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: All tools up — when he dashes in to Spirit Cleave near a wall, E him into it and the stun holds him through his rewind.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Soul Unbound's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: It evens: your flat damage stops scaling while his W points add up, so lean on Q's max-HP chunk and trade short around Spirit Cleave.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Soul Unbound's cooldown.
edits.after: Iceborn Gauntlet keeps you trading while W denies his engage — force fights before his crit items.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Yone carry threat 9/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: He reclaims it: crit items let his Q3 blow through your CC and Soul Unbound rewinds out of your E. Frontline, do not duel.

edits.before: Yours from level 1. See the level-by-level chart for the swing points.
edits.after: Yours from level 2 until his crit items land. Plan recalls around that.

edits.before: Your W disables his dashes — ground his E + Q3. Poppy wins the Soul Unbound cooldown windows.
edits.after: W grounds his Q3 dash, not his E — bait Spirit Cleave's shield, then E-wall-stun him.

edits.before: Ground his dashes and wall-stun him. Track Soul Unbound before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Ground the Q3 dash with W, wall-stun him, and force Spirit Cleave's shield out before you commit.

edits.before: E Yone into a wall when his answer is down, Q the zone under him, and W any dash he tries — his mobility is a suggestion.
edits.after: E him into a wall once Spirit Cleave (14s) is spent, Q the zone under him, and hold W for his Q3 — that is the dash it stops.

edits.before: E-ing with no wall behind him — the wall-stun is the whole trade; the dash alone is a tickle.
edits.after: Committing into a fresh Spirit Cleave — the shield eats your burst and his Q3 knocks you up.

edits.before: His mobility — your W disables his dashes! Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1 and is not a dash — W cannot stop the return.

edits.before: E Yone into a wall when his answer is down, Q the zone under him, and W any dash he tries — his mobility is a suggestion.
edits.after: Two Mortal Steel stacks turn his Q into a dash-knockup — that is the one W grounds. Hold Steadfast Presence for it, never for poke.

edits.before: Yone wastes Soul Unbound (Dash) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Spirit Cleave shields him on a 14s cooldown — bait it out before you commit.

edits.before: That is Yone's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Two Mortal Steel stacks make it a dash plus knockup — sidestep the second.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Spent on poke, his Q3 dash lands free for the next 20 seconds.

edits.before: E-ing with no wall behind him — the wall-stun is the whole trade; the dash alone is a tickle.
edits.after: His spirit snaps back to where it started — you are chasing a body already gone.

edits.before: Track Yone's Soul Unbound (Dash): His mobility — your W disables his dashes! When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Soul Unbound (22s) is not a dash; W grounds his Q3 instead. Bait Spirit Cleave's shield, then E-Q.

notes: Two real errors. (1) The page told the user Steadfast Presence grounds Soul Unbound; Riot's text and the kit flags make it a spirit-return with a move-speed buff, no dash. The dash W stops is Mortal Steel at two stacks. (2) Spirit Cleave was absent from the entire page even though its 14s shield is what eats Poppy's burst window. Also fixed: diff read EVEN while diffRating, tone and report[14] all say favoured.
